title: The 4 Best Baby Bottles for Newborns
h1: The 4 Best Baby Bottles for Newborns
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for baby bottles for newborns, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby bottles for newborns using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Philips Avent Natural Baby Bottles, Medium Flow, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Available in newborn and first-flow nipple options, Wide, breast-shaped nipple for latch-matching, AirFree anti-colic valve.
strengths: Newborn-specific flow nipples slow things down enough for early sucking and swallowing coordination
Wide nipple shape eases the transition for babies who will also be breastfed
Fewest parts of any bottle here, a real time saver during frequent newborn feeds and washes
limitations: AirFree valve only vents fully when held mostly vertical
9oz size is more bottle than a newborn needs, size down if buying newborn-specific bottles
Nipple collapse reported occasionally once babies move to faster flows
features: Available in newborn and first-flow nipple options
3 parts per bottle for easy washing

products.name: Dr. Brown's Options+ Narrow Glass Baby Bottles, 4oz/8oz 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 4oz size included in this 4-pack, right-sized for early feeds, Internal vent system that routes air away from milk, Level 1 slow-flow nipple included.
strengths: 4oz bottles in this pack match a newborn's actual intake far better than a 9oz bottle
Vent system has the deepest anti-colic research history in this category, useful for gassier newborns
Level 1 nipple is genuinely slow, appropriate for the first weeks
limitations: Most parts per bottle of any major brand, a real burden during round-the-clock newborn feeds
Vent system needs correct threading or it leaks at the collar
Glass bottles are heavier to hold one-handed during long newborn feeding sessions
features: 4oz size included in this 4-pack, right-sized for early feeds
Internal vent system that routes air away from milk

products.name: Comotomo Baby Bottle, Double Pack, 5oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 5oz size, right-sized for newborn feeds, 100% medical-grade silicone body, Ships with a slow-flow nipple for 0 to 3 months.
strengths: 5oz size and slow-flow nipple are appropriately scaled for a newborn's actual intake
Silicone body's soft texture is the closest tactile match to skin, useful for babies also breastfeeding
Wide opening lets tired parents wipe most of the bottle clean without a brush at 3am
limitations: Among the pricier options per bottle, a real cost when buying enough for round-the-clock newborn feeds
Wide barrel does not fit every bottle warmer
Silicone shows fingerprints and grip marks faster than hard plastic
features: Ships with a slow-flow nipple for 0 to 3 months

products.name: Nanobebe Breastmilk and Silicone Baby Bottle Complete Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 5oz size included, appropriate for newborn intake, Breast-shaped bowl design for fast, even warming, Slow-flow anti-colic vented nipple.
strengths: 5oz size matches a newborn's early intake without needing to portion down from a larger bottle
Fast, even warming helps during frequent newborn feeds when every minute of a fussy wait matters
Complete set's pump adapter simplifies a newborn pumping and bottle-feeding routine from day one
limitations: Priced as a full set rather than a simple starter bottle pack
Wide bowl shape needs a specific bottle warmer insert to heat evenly
features: 5oz size included, appropriate for newborn intake
Breast-shaped bowl design for fast, even warming
Bundled with a pump adapter and pacifiers

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
